# NetworkMessageRuleBuilderContext

[API index](../index.md)

Configure a network-message rule whose predicate and action receive a `NetworkMessage`.
Fluent methods update and return the same builder; attach `.Do(...)` to handle messages.

**@keywords**

network, message, rules, builder, callback

## If

```typescript
If(predicate: (networkmessage: NetworkMessage) => boolean): this;
```

Handle a message only when its predicate returns true; replaces any earlier predicate.

**@keywords**

network, predicate, condition, filter

## Cooldown

```typescript
Cooldown(cooldown_ms: number): this;
```

Limit action frequency; messages arriving during cooldown are skipped, not delayed for later.

**Parameter `cooldown_ms`**

Minimum milliseconds between fires; non-positive or non-finite values disable it.

**@keywords**

network, cooldown, throttle, rate limit

## Group

```typescript
Group(group: GroupScope | string): this;
```

Bind the rule to an existing group handle or a group name.
A disabled group suppresses message handling.

**@keywords**

network, groups, enable, disable

## Do

```typescript
Do(action: (networkmessage: NetworkMessage) => unknown): this;
```

Set the callback for matching messages; replaces any earlier action.
Sleep and returned Promises suppress new deliveries until completion; rule context survives waits.
Stop abandons automation-owned continuations without JS finally; the host releases held input.
A rule without Do handles nothing.

**@keywords**

network, message, action, callback
